annotations.title: Get dealer prices for a product

description: Current listed US dealer prices for one tracked bullion product, lowest first, with per-dealer stock status (in_stock vs out_of_stock / unavailable in dealers_unavailable). Sorted by price only. Some links are affiliate links; we may earn a commission. Prices checked in the last 120 minutes (one short price feed: 60) are ranked and returned; older prices are never ranked. Each answer also lists tracked dealers with no live price (dealers_without_live_price). Never substitutes a different weight. Standard tool free; for a version fine-tuned or customized to your business, email for pricing via https://bullionpricecheck.com/contact/.

limit.description: Maximum number of dealers to return.

payment.description: bank = check/ACH/wire price (default); card = the dealer's listed credit card price.

product.description: Product slug from list_products (for example american-silver-eagle-1oz) or a name with its weight, such as "1 oz silver eagle". A name only matches a product of the same weight. If the product is not tracked, the tool returns an error naming the closest tracked products.

name: get_dealer_prices

best_feed.description: Lowest dealer feed price, fetched by us from a feed with no per-item price time: never live, never ranked, never badged. Present only when lower than best_live or no live price exists.

best_live.description: Lowest live price (checked within the freshness limit): the only row that can be called best.

dealers_without_live_price.description: Tracked dealers with no live price for this product (unavailable, or last check older than 120 minutes / one short price feed: 60).
